text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gave a powerful run in the 
Sirius Stakes. She received words of 
passion from the Trainer of an Umamusume 
who was very much like herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying countless hopes and dreams, she 
was fully motivated. Right now, she might 
even be able to put up a good fight 
against Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To test her strength, she decided to run 
in the Tokyo Daishoten held at Oi at the 
end of the year.
